acceptance_rule.meaning: mutual cross-model NN in canonical space (5-fold CV adapters) among all live candidates
acceptance_rule.roundtrip: A->canon->B space->B NN concept->canon->A space NN == self (and B->A->B)
acceptance_rule.geometry: per-concept RSA Spearman >=0.3 (raw spaces); if in a kept relation, mean pair offset cos A/B >=0.3
acceptance_rule.readability: canonical vector decoded into each model, J-lens readout over v1 anchors+concept tokens, column z-scored; concept word/synonym in top 20 for BOTH models
